scope: Train batches only. No fitting trajectories, V selection or E access. Shared LoRA/Adam/RNG state across all four variants. Historical results immutable.
decision: Numerical parity required. Report resource ratios without changing old FAIL. >=20% peak reduction vs checkpointed standard is the old memory target, not a new overall PASS. Lower memory and <=5% time overhead vs standard supports further study; time-only benefit is reported separately. No automatic expanded fits; side remains a required subsequent comparator.
